Name: Fossil Slugger
Design brief: A recognisable long tapered baseball bat with a broad ivory fossil-bone barrel, three chunky tan rib-like rings fused around the upper barrel, dark navy collar and a dark brown wrapped grip. One simple embossed dinosaur footprint on the barrel, blunt rounded end, no skull, blades or spikes.

Name: Dragon Scale
Design brief: A long tapered baseball bat with a glossy emerald barrel clad in four broad overlapping rounded dragon-scale bands, golden end cap and collar, plum-purple grip and gold knob. Three small rounded gold dorsal ridges attached along the back of the barrel. A simple cream oval inset, no eyes or dragon head.

Name: Breakfast Bonker
Design brief: A long baseball bat with a golden toasted waffle-patterned barrel, broad shallow 3-by-5 waffle grid following its rounded cylinder, a glossy caramel cap dripping a little onto the top third, cream butter-coloured rim. Short cream grip with two caramel rings and a golden knob. Entire object remains an elongated tapered bat, not a flat waffle paddle.

Name: Cloud Nine
Design brief: An elegant chunky baseball bat with a pearl-white rounded barrel, sky-blue lower taper, two broad embossed feather panels wrapping along the barrel and a lavender collar. Small thick gold ring at the barrel tip, lavender grip and cream knob. All features attached, no floating cloud or angel, no detached halo.

Name: Bamboo Bruiser
Design brief: A recognisable baseball bat made of glossy jade-green bamboo-like segments, thick broad upper barrel and smoothly narrowing shaft, pale cream node bands, dark navy collar, tan rope-textured handgrip rendered as four simple broad wraps and flat green knob. Two small cream leaf-shaped engravings near the top, no loose leaves.

Name: Arcade Combo
Design brief: A chunky baseball bat with a dark violet elongated cylindrical barrel with broad cyan edge rails and exactly three large glossy arcade buttons arranged lengthwise, red yellow and mint. Cream inset panel behind buttons, magenta collar, navy rubber grip with turquoise rings and magenta knob. Blunt rounded tip, no screen text or cords.

Name: Honeycomb Hitter
Design brief: A warm amber baseball bat with a rounded barrel wrapped in five large golden hexagonal honeycomb panels, a few broad opaque golden honey drips moulded against its surface, cream tip cap, navy collar and black-and-yellow striped rubber grip. Amber knob. No bees, no jars, no separate honey puddles.

Name: Clockwork Clobber
Design brief: A copper and cream baseball bat with a long thick tapered barrel, two broad navy collars and one LARGE simple brass gear inset into the barrel side. A small chunky wind-up key attached near its upper back edge. Teal rubber grip and copper knob. Smooth toy clockwork, no loose cogs or tiny mechanisms.

Name: Patchwork Popper
Design brief: A long rounded baseball bat with purple and mint-green broad stitched fabric-like panels, simple cream cross stitches and one large round orange button mounted near the upper barrel. Navy collar, orange grip with purple wraps and mint knob. Glossy toy appearance, blunt cap, no gore or exposed stuffing.

Name: Prism Champion
Design brief: A spectacular long baseball bat with an opaque faceted royal-purple and cyan crystal barrel, six broad flat facets, a blunt chamfered tip and two thick cream-and-gold reinforcing collars. Dark navy grip with lavender chevrons and a gold knob. Rich opaque gem surfaces, no transparency, particles, floating shards or sharp spear point.
